description.zh:
- 01：个人卡证类
  - 0101：身份证
  - 0102：银行卡
  - 0104：教师资格证
  - 0107：学生证
- 02：经营场景类
  - 0201：门头照
  - 0202：柜台照
  - 0203：场景照
- 03：企业资质类
  - 0301：工商营业执照
description.en:
The credential name. Valid values:

- 01: personal card and certificate
  - 0101: ID card
  - 0102: bank card
  - 0104: teacher qualification certificate
  - 0107: student ID card
- 02: business scenario
  - 0201: storefront photo
  - 0202: counter photo
  - 0203: scene photo
- 03: enterprise qualification
  - 0301: business license.

description.zh:
凭证类型：

- 01：个人卡证类
- 02：经营场景类
- 03：企业资质类
description.en:
The credential type. Valid values:

- 01: personal card and certificate
- 02: business scenario
- 03: enterprise qualification.
The Base64-encoded image. Specify either imageUrl or imageContext.
The image URL. Specify either imageUrl or imageContext.

Specifies whether to enable authoritative verification. Valid values:

- **0**: Disabled.
- **1**: Enabled.

description.zh:
是否开启OCR识别。

- **0**：否
- **1**：是

仅当**CredType**取值**01**时，**isOCR**可设置为**1**。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable optical character recognition (OCR). Valid values:

- **0**: Disabled.
- **1**: Enabled.

You can set **isOCR** to **1** only when **CredType** is set to **01**.
This parameter is required when PromptModel is set to DEFAULT.

description.zh: 商户编号。****CredName****取值**02**时，此字段需要输入。
description.en: The merchant ID. This parameter is required when **CredName** is set to **02**.

description.zh:
调用模式：

* ANTI_FAKE_CHECK:  图片防伪检测

* ANTI_FAKE_VL:  图片防伪检测及语义理解

* IMAGE_VL_COG：图片语义理解

默认取值 ANTI_FAKE_CHECK

当且仅当CredType取值02时，ProductCode才能取值为ANTI_FAKE_VL或者IMAGE_VL_COG
description.en:
The call mode. Valid values:

* ANTI_FAKE_CHECK: image anti-forgery detection.

* ANTI_FAKE_VL: image anti-forgery detection and semantic understanding.

* IMAGE_VL_COG: image semantic understanding.

Default value: ANTI_FAKE_CHECK.

ProductCode can be set to ANTI_FAKE_VL or IMAGE_VL_COG only when CredType is set to 02.

description.zh:
图片语义理解，客户自定义prompt内容。

当PromptModel取值CUSTOM，此项必输。
description.en:
The custom prompt content for image semantic understanding.

This parameter is required when PromptModel is set to CUSTOM.

description.zh:
图片语义理解prompt获取方式：

* DEFAULT：系统默认

* CUSTOM：客户自定义

说明：当ProductCode取值ANTI_FAKE_VL或者IMAGE_VL_COG时，此项参数必传。
description.en:
The method to obtain the prompt for image semantic understanding. Valid values:

* DEFAULT: system default.

* CUSTOM: custom.

Note: This parameter is required when ProductCode is set to ANTI_FAKE_VL or IMAGE_VL_COG.

descriptions.zh:
- 服务地址：cloudauth.aliyuncs.com（IPv4）或cloudauth-dualstack.aliyuncs.com（IPv6）。
- 请求方法：POST和GET。
- 传输协议：HTTPS。
descriptions.en:
- Service endpoint: cloudauth.aliyuncs.com (IPv4) or cloudauth-dualstack.aliyuncs.com (IPv6).
- Request method: POST and GET.
- Transfer protocol: HTTPS.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth credential-verify --cred-type 01 --cred-name 0104 --image-url http://marry.momocdn.com/avatar/3B/B6/3BB6527E-7467-926E-1048-B43614F20CC420230803_L.jpg --image-context base64 --is-ocr 1 --is-check 0 --user-name '张0' --identify-num 429001000000008211 --cert-num 460100000 --merchant-id '无。' --product-code ANTI_FAKE_CHECK --prompt-model DEFAULT --prompt '无' --merchant-detail Value=关键字 Key=keyword --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth CredentialVerify --region cn-hangzhou --MerchantDetail '[{"Value":"关键字","Key":"keyword"}]' --UserName '张0' --ProductCode ANTI_FAKE_CHECK --IdentifyNum 429001000000008211 --ImageUrl 'http://marry.momocdn.com/avatar/3B/B6/3BB6527E-7467-926E-1048-B43614F20CC420230803_L.jpg' --MerchantId '无。' --CredName 0104 --IsOCR 1 --PromptModel DEFAULT --CertNum 460100000 --Prompt '无' --IsCheck 0 --CredType 01 --ImageContext base64
